आ, ऐ and औ are called वृद्धि।

Terms: वृद्धि

That word, among the vowels of which the first is a वृद्धि , is called वृद्धम्। 

Terms: वृद्धम्

The वृद्ध (or patronymic गोत्र word becomes एकशेष and is retained, when compounded) with a patronymic word युवन् , provided that the specific difference in form between them be in their signs (affix) only.

Terms: वृद्ध

After the verbs वृत् 'to exist' etc., परस्मैपद is optionally used when the affixes स्य (Future and conditional) and सन् (Desiderative) follow.

Terms: परस्मैपद

When contempt is to be expressed, the affix ठक् is diversely added in the senses of a descendant after a वृद्ध word denoting सौवीर गोत्र-s.

Terms: ठक्

The गोत्र is sometimes optionally regarded as युवन् when respectful reference to him is intended.

Terms: युवन्

The affix ञ्यङ् comes in the sense of descendant after a word having वृद्धि in the first syllable and after a word ending in short इ and after the words 1. कोसल and 2. अजाद when they are the names of countries and क्षत्रिय-s.

Terms: ञ्यङ्

After the word वृद्ध , the affix छ is added in the remaining senses.

Terms: छ

The affixes ठञ् comes in the remaining senses after a वृद्ध word ending in उ and denoting a locality of East-folks.

Terms: ठञ्

The affix छ comes in the remaining senses after a वृद्ध word denoting a place and ending with अक् or इक् or having ख as its penultimate.

Terms: छ

ज्य is also substituted for वृद्ध when the affixes इष्ठन् and इयसुन् follow.

Terms: इष्ठन् and इयसुन्

The वृद्धि is the single substitute of अ or आ of a preceding word and the initial dipthong of the succeeding (अ or आ + dipthong = वृद्धि)।

Terms: संहितायाम्

The feminine is not changed into masculine when it is formed by such a तद्धित affix which causes the वृद्धि of the first syllable with exception however of तद्धित-substitute meaning 'coloured therewith' and 'made thereof'.

Terms: Masculisation
